visualCharacteristics.structure: results count + Filter button, filter tray (checkbox chip groups per tag namespace), sticky title bar, card grid (image, headline, description, color swatches), load more
visualCharacteristics.layout: 1-up mobile / 2-up tablet / 3-up desktop grid of rounded image cards; left sliding modal filter tray with Clear All + View N results pill buttons; fixed sticky bar (title + Filter) once the controls scroll away

contentPattern: Key/value rows: sticky-title | Inspiration; prefilters | comma-separated tag keys (may be empty); optional source | query index URL (default /inspiration/cards/query-index.json); optional tags | tag sheet URL (default /docs/library/tagging.json). Cards come from the index, not from authored rows.
